summary: Iter78: SNAPSHOTS section redesign verified across Sample Report, Free Preview and Premium Report. Backend demo API returns 4 snapshot_moments with correct keys and frame URLs (all 4 demo images HTTP 200). Sample Report renders v2-snapshots-section with amber demo note, 4 photo cards (00:58 / 01:28 / 03:59 / 02:40), no 'Next Milestone', glance strip, quote bar. No horizontal overflow at 390px. All regression sections (hero, parent-summary, overall, match-stats + age-comparison in 2-col row below snapshots, top-strengths, dev-priorities, roadmap, footer) still render. Free Preview (locked report seeded via disposable user smtest.iter78) shows fpl-snapshots with '1 of 4 unlocked' pill, ONE unlocked card with real strength title 'Explosive 1v1 dribbling' + real poster + timestamp, THREE locked blurred cards with lock icons and 'Unlocks with the full report', and 'Unlock all 4 moments' button that correctly scrolls to #scout-packages. No premium content leaked. Premium Report (unlocked seeded report) shows real-mode snapshots: snapshot-real-note (not demo-note), 4 cards derived from action_timeline with real timestamps (00:15, 01:32, 02:40) and titles ('Wing burst past defender', 'Scan then switch', 'Weak-foot slip'), stylized dark-green pitch fallback for cards without matching verified frames (hidden, develop). No red console errors on any page. Test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: snapshots.jsx: for real (non-demo) reports, if buildSnapMoment cannot find a matching event for a snapshot key (e.g. hidden talent when tokens don't overlap action_timeline), the card has no timestamp and no 'See moment' button in the glance strip (see hidden key in test). Acceptable but consider a fallback timestamp from the source event even when title comes from snapshot.hidden_talent.

PremiumReportV2.jsx test-ids: v2-action-timeline and v2-training-week do not exist as data-testids on the rendered sample report (only v2-match-stats-card, v2-age-comparison-card, v2-top-strengths-card, v2-dev-priorities-card, v2-roadmap-card, v2-report-footer are exposed). Minor gap for automated regression coverage.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter78 SNAPSHOTS redesign fully verified. To retest premium report with a real unlocked report, seed via /app/backend/tests/seed_iter78_fpl.py then update the unlocked report with is_paid=true and manually_unlocked=true (the API sanitizer strips full_report unless the payment/unlocked flags are set). The unlocked flag on the raw doc alone is NOT sufficient — the server checks is_paid/manually_unlocked in the read path.
